title: Zingy Zippy Deodeok-Roasted Pulao
description: A tangy, springy, nostalgic Bengali dish featuring deodeok-root that is both diabetic-friendly and easy to prepare.

ingredients.name: deodeok-root
ingredients.notes: preferably fresh, can be used dried

instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add deodeok-root and sauté for about 5 minutes until softened.
Stir in ginger, garlic, cumin seeds, mustard seeds, curry leaves, and salt. Cook for another minute.
Gradually add brown basmati rice to the root mixture, mixing well with the spices.
Pour enough water over the rice to cover it by about 1 cm. Bring to a boil then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer until all water is absorbed (about 20 minutes).
Fluff with a fork before serving.
